description: Defines the ObliviousHttpRequest class for client-side encryption and server-side decryption of HTTP payloads using HPKE, including context management and request serialization.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpRequest
classes.description: Handles creation, serialization, and management of oblivious HTTP requests with client and server functionalities.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::Context
classes.description: Stores HPKE context data associated with an HTTP request, used during request processing and response handling.

methods.name: CreateServerObliviousRequest
methods.description: Parses an encrypted OHTTP request from data, returning an ObliviousHttpRequest object.

methods.name: CreateClientObliviousRequest
methods.description: Creates an OHTTP request from plaintext payload and public key.

methods.name: CreateClientWithSeedForTesting
methods.description: Creates an OHTTP request with a specified seed for testing purposes.

methods.name: EncapsulateAndSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the OHTTP request into bytes for transmission.

methods.name: GetPlaintextData
methods.description: Retrieves the plaintext payload from the request after decapsulation.

methods.name: ReleaseContext
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the request's HPKE context to the caller.
